# Previous MegaPlayer sources

[MegaBenchOS](../../../../README.md) / [Music](../../../../music/README.md) / [Original sources](../../README.md) / Previous selections

This folder keeps Ambient Thing and Indoor Wolf Extended Dance Remix for source provenance and reproducible conversion. They are not part of the current five-track ROM library.

The original VGMs and [provenance manifest](provenance.json) are available for reproducible conversion. This directory contains source assets only.

The installed SGDK converter can regenerate these tracks using the archive manifest. See [music conversion](../../../../docs/MUSIC_CONVERSION.md) and [current track credits](../../../../music/CREDITS.md).

## Licensing

The parent [CC0 licence](../LICENSE) covers these sources. The manifest retains creator, source and licence evidence.
